Chezmoi dotfiles repo: source `~/.local/share/chezmoi/`, target `~/`, repo https://github.com/pascalandy/dotfiles. Sync via `chezmoi apply` (copies, not symlinks). Files in `~/` that are managed by chezmoi should NEVER be edited directly. Always edit the source in `~/.local/share/chezmoi/` or use `chezmoi edit`.
chezmoi managed | grep <filename>
chezmoi edit ~/.zshrc
`dot_`=dotfile; `private_`=600/700; `executable_`=execute; `symlink_`=symlink; `.tmpl`=template; `run_before_`=before apply; `run_after_`=every apply; `run_once_`=first apply.
chezmoi add ~/.newfile
git add . && git commit -m "message" && git push
Store user scripts in `~/.local/bin/`.
code ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chmod +x ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
chezmoi add ~/.local/bin/[script-name]
Stored as `dot_local/bin/executable_[script-name]`.
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
Script names should NOT have `.sh` extension.
Bash template: `dot_config/opencode/skill/bash/scripts/pref_bash_script_template.sh`
set -euo pipefail
Functions `fct_*`; logging `log_*`; constants/env `UPPER_CASE`; locals `lower_case`.
Files containing `{{ .variable }}` MUST have `.tmpl` extension. Variables: `~/.config/chezmoi/chezmoi.toml`. Inspect: `chezmoi cat ~/.zshrc`
Scripts: `.chezmoiscripts/` (v2.9+): `run_before_sync.sh`, `run_after_backup.sh`. See `.chezmoiignore`, `crash_procedure.md`, https://www.chezmoi.io/user-guide/command-overview/
Before solving from scratch, search cass. ⚠️ NEVER run bare cass — it launches an interactive TUI. Always use --robot or --json.
cass search "authentication error" --robot --limit 5
cass view /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 --json
cass expand /path/to/session.jsonl -n 42 -C 3 --json
cass capabilities --json
cass robot-docs guide
`stdout = data only, stderr = diagnostics. Exit 0 = success.`
